description: Pinned-lake snapshot (Component 1) — authoritative reference every reproducibility leg copies into its isolated MAKE_MAGIC_DATA_DIR. Pins the coherent lake the re-baselined P0 SHAs are valid against.
extraction_reads_note: CORRECTED 2026-11-18 (adversarial verdict): the full-corpus extraction reads oracle_cards + card_otag + combo via the lake query path, AND derive_card_events reads raw/oracle_tags.parquet directly as the adjacency taxonomy (derive_card_events.py ~1222-1251). A lake WITHOUT oracle_tags silently falls back to the enumerated adjacency (a different algorithm; ADR-0022 warning fires - behaviorally verified). Any isolated data dir MUST seed all FOUR files in this manifest. The earlier claim that oracle_tags is unread was wrong; see verdict-report.md.

normalized/card_otag.parquet.note: Re-rolled from the coherent df31df7c raw tags (pipeline.transforms.otag_rollup); the coherent file FULL_CORPUS ec917355 reflects.

normalized/combo.parquet.note: The combo mart (combo.load_combos_from_lake). Fourth extraction-read file; not in implementation.md's '3 parquets'.

raw/oracle_tags.parquet.drift_note: DRIFTED. card_otag (a51097a5) was rolled from oracle_tags df31df7c (bytes 4393150, mtime 2026-11-18T00:31:11), the coherent source. During the Phase-2 full pytest suite a test performed a LIVE Scryfall oracle_tags.sync() that overwrote raw/oracle_tags.parquet with the upstream 10:00 version (9289959165..., bytes 4394431, cursor 2026-11-18T10:00:37). df31df7c is no longer on the live disk and is unrecoverable from live. Upstream re-fetches tags live anyway; the pinned check must NOT rebuild card_otag from this file.
